# Player at (18,11)-(23,16), green (25,18)-(28,21), blue (25,24)-(28,27), red (13,42)-(16,45)
# Green and blue follow player, red doesn't
#
# Need to pick up red. Move player to red's row, retract path, extend to red
# First: move UP to red's row
result = action(['UP'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'M' and n['pixels'] == 18:
        b = n['boundary']
        r_min = min(row for row, col in b)
        print(f"Player row: {r_min}")
# Now retract path LEFT fully
result = action(['LEFT'] * 10)
seg = current_frame.segmentation
path_max_col = 0
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'w':
        b = n['boundary']
        c_max = max(col for _,col in b)
        path_max_col = max(path_max_col, c_max)
print(f"Path max col after LEFT x10: {path_max_col}")
# Now extend RIGHT to reach red at col 42
result = action(['RIGHT'] * 10)
seg = current_frame.segmentation
path_max_col = 0
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'w':
        b = n['boundary']
        c_max = max(col for _,col in b)
        path_max_col = max(path_max_col, c_max)
print(f"Path max col after RIGHT x10: {path_max_col}")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] == 16 and n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N']:
        b = n['boundary']
        r_min = min(row for row, col in b)
        if r_min < 50:
            c_min = min(col for _,col in b)
            c_max = max(col for _,col in b)
            r_max = max(row for row,col in b)
            print(f"{n['color']}: ({r_min},{c_min})-({r_max},{c_max})")
</parameter>
</function>
